verdict.rationale: LangSmith is a SaaS platform with an API (traces can be filtered and exported 'via the UI or API'), so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, no evidence shows one is published: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.langchain.com returning 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes, not API specs, so they earn no credit here.
